steps: Real browser image File/DataTransfer paste and dragover/drop events on both search text fields never open the media importer or highlight the authoring drop target. Network capture observes no upload (including XHR), and source, selection, dirty state, input events, registry and assets stay unchanged. These are real DOM bubbling checks using synthetic events, not an OS clipboard claim.

Real Ctrl+F from the native source editor opens literal search. Case-sensitive and insensitive counts, Next/Previous, both wrap directions, and no-match navigation select only exact matches without changing text, dirty state, input events or author files.

An independent full-text DOM Range measurement verifies the far speed match is visible after a very long wrapped CJK/emoji JSON string. Search operates on the current BOM/CRLF-backed draft; the build fixture only runs static validation.
An open Go to line modal blocks replacement even when an underlying button is invoked directly. Cancel preserves the exact source selection and restores the search action.
Replace current affects only the selected literal match and uses native undo/redo. The existing diagnostic becomes changed after replacement and remains changed after Undo restores the source.
Existing source indentation shortcuts still work with search open, while the same shortcut in a search field leaves the source untouched.

Replace All changes all three matches in one native input operation and one Undo restores all of them. Replacement text $&/$1 stays literal, and searching the resulting dollar/sign characters finds exactly three matches.

Chinese, English and Japanese search controls fit 390px. Each input and action remains reachable in the scrollable source pane, with a usable textarea. Language changes preserve query/replacement/case/count, source selection, and the native undo/redo history.

Closing search preserves source and selection; real Cmd+F reopens it. The shortcut remains scoped to the source textarea and leaves other text fields alone. Search and replacements never save automatically.

Ordinary Save is the only persistence operation: exactly one source request, only the target scene changes, BOM and CRLF are preserved, and templates/registry/assets remain identical. Switching documents clears the old search panel and both query fields. No engine project is generated or executed.
